args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring (and FIN-212)
specify banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values
round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66). Fixes failing
tests/test_money.py in the nightly build.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py:round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring (and FIN-212) specify banker's rounding.
- Switched the import and `quantize` call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`), fixing the failing `tests/test_money.py` in the nightly build.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
